title: Air Fryer Haloumi Schnitzel Subs
subtitle: with Slaw and Green Goddess Dressing
description: Whether you’re full-time vego or part-time only, our varied range of vegetarian dishes really hits the spot. Bursting with veggies, dairy, legumes, grains and nuts, they’re packed with flavour, they’ll fill you up and they’re totally mouth-watering too!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the air fryer to 200C (see Don't have an air fryer?). Preheat the oven to 200C, fan-forced, for the bread rolls. Thinly slice the cabbage with a sharp knife or mandoline. Thinly slice the spring onion. Halve the bread rolls through the middle, taking care not to cut all the way through. Cut the haloumi into 4 equal slices.

Crumb haloumi: Whisk 1 egg in a shallow bowl. Put the breadcrumbs and 1 tbs plain flour in separate shallow bowls. Dust the haloumi with the flour, shake off the excess, then dip in the egg and coat in the breadcrumbs.
Air-fry haloumi: Put the haloumi in the air-fryer basket. Air-fry the haloumi, turning halfway, for 8 mins or until golden.

Toast rolls and make slaw: Meanwhile, put the rolls on an oven tray, cut-side up, and bake for 3-4 mins until warmed through. While the rolls are toasting, combine 1½ tbs olive oil, 1 tbs red wine vinegar and 1½ tsp dijon mustard in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Add the cabbage and half the spring onion and toss to combine.

Serve up: Fill the rolls with half the slaw and the haloumi. Divide the haloumi subs and the remaining slaw among plates. Drizzle with the green goddess dressing and scatter over the remaining spring onion. Enjoy!
Don't have an air fryer?: No worries, you can cook the crumbed haloumi in the oven. Put on a lined oven tray, spray with olive oil and bake, turning halfway, until golden.
